power.flare_eclipse

fire.prevention

combat.manhunter
Manhunters: close all doors, undraft and bring everyone indoors, forbid outdoor work; they leave in 24-54h. Only shoot from behind doors/walls or with turrets. Afterwards butcher corpses fast.
combat.siege

Siege: do not wait in wooden buildings. Either counter-mortar or sortie with all fighters early, before their mortars and sandbags are finished (assault comes in 1.5-3 days anyway). Keep non-combatants under roofs. Siegers respect your blueprints, so they will not build on planned structures.
combat.drop_pods
Drop pods: draft nearest armed colonists, move non-combatants into roofed inner rooms, fight from door and furniture cover; target grenadiers first.
combat.sappers
Sappers/breachers ignore the killbox: find their dig path, set up behind cover at the expected breach point, kill the digger/breacher first.
combat.assault

Assault: draft fighters into the killzone or behind walls/sandbags at the chokepoint; up to 3 melee blockers at the door vs melee rushes; focus fire grenadiers > breachers > attackers in melee > rest. Humans flee after 40-70% losses.
combat.sniper
Sniper party: keep everyone behind walls out of line of sight; let them close in, then engage from cover or rush with shields.
combat.mechs

Mechs never flee: fight only from cover at a chokepoint, lure them close (they outrange you in the open), EMP to stun, focus scythers at the door, centipede weapons, rush pikemen with shields. Use armor-piercing weapons.
combat.mech_cluster

Mech cluster or ancient danger: do not approach (proximity wakes it; ancient dangers no longer wake while still fogged). Build cover first, then strike from max range: EMP then HE mortars/snipers. Do not melee explosive parts.
combat.outmatched
Outmatched in the open: pull everyone inside, hold an inner room with doors and cover, let raiders loot and leave; fight only at chokepoints.
combat.retreat_wounded
Pull wounded fighters behind doors; rescue downed colonists when the area is covered; rotate fresh melee blockers.
combat.post_raid
After the raid: rescue and tend colonists, capture downed raiders only if a prisoner bed is free and food_days >= 10, haul corpses away to a grave/dump, sell loot you will not use.
defense.build
Threat outgrows the fighters: build a defended chokepoint (1-wide bent entrance, walls and sandbags for shooters, traps in the funnel); arm everyone capable.
defense.arm
Give every capable fighter a weapon (craft bolt-action rifles/revolvers after Gunsmithing; buy guns).
defense.turrets
Place 2+ mini-turrets 3-4 tiles apart behind sandbags at the killzone, on a switchable separate grid. Treat traps as filler only: smart raiders avoid some.
defense.siege_ready
Sieges are possible from 500 points (1.6): research Mortars and keep a counter-mortar position.
defense.infestation_risk
Infestation risk under overhead mountain: wall off unused mountain tiles (or every second tile), light the area, keep a melee block ready; destroy every hive if they come.
defense.wealth_jump
Wealth is outpacing defense: sell or use surplus goods and silver, let junk gear rot, invest in armor/turrets instead of luxury stockpiles.
event.toxic_fallout
Toxic fallout: everyone and all animals under roof; switch outdoor jobs off; ~24h outside (40% buildup) risks permanent dementia/carcinoma. Masks help [Biotech].
event.volcanic_winter
Volcanic winter (7.5-40 d, -7C, -30% light): grow more, greenhouse with sun lamps, conserve food, expect weaker solar.
event.blight
Blight: Plant cut priority 1, cut every blighted plant now; leave 4+ tile gaps between fields in future.
event.flashstorm
Flashstorm: expect lightning fires; Firefight priority 1; keep pawns near the base.
event.psychic_drone
Psychic drone: affected gender loses mood; give recreation and good meals; delay stressful work.
event.pollution
Acidic smog: keep pawns indoors where possible, haul items indoors (they decay faster outside); dispose of wastepacks with an atomizer or far from the colony.
research.idle
Pick research by current bottleneck (see research.order); never leave the bench idle.
research.order

Default order (crashlanded): Battery, Stonecutting, Microelectronics, Complex furniture, Gunsmithing, Smithing, Machining, Gun turrets, Mortars, Flak armor, Drug production, Medicine production, Air conditioning, Hi-tech bench, Multi-analyzer, Fabrication, Deep drilling, Autocannon, Precision rifling, Charged shot, Recon/Marine armor, then ship tree. Biome overrides: hot -> Passive cooler then Air conditioning first; cold/ice -> Hydroponics + sun lamp early; tropical -> Penoxycyline; desert -> Moisture pump.
research.lab_room
Put research benches in their own enclosed lab room (benches outside a lab work slower in 1.6).
growth.recruit
Room to grow: capture or recruit a colonist who fills a skill gap (cook, doctor, shooter, grower); warden reduces resistance first.
growth.trade
Spend silver (it counts as wealth): buy components, industrial medicine, armor and good guns from traders via the comms console.
growth.quest_accept
Quest acceptable if its reward fixes a current bottleneck; avoid threatened joiner, peace talks without a top negotiator, hospitality/pawn lending during disease.
growth.caravan_safety
Caravans: send 2-3 pawns plus pack animals, food days >= travel time x2 + 3, keep >= 2 fighters, a doctor and a cook at home; pemmican or survival meals for long trips.
growth.idle_build
Calm period: do the next comfort or defense project (bedrooms, rec room, hospital, stone walls, killzone), in that order of greatest current need.
work.baseline

Manual priorities: everyone Firefight, Patient, Bed rest, Basic at 1; each specialist job at 1 for its best pawn; passion jobs 2; hauling/cleaning 3-4; keep 2 doctors and 2 cooks able. [Odyssey] Fishing is a separate work type: assign it when water is near and food is short.
